title: Come Up the Mountain with Me
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Isaiah saw a shining hill
Where every soul could go,
"Come, let us climb it side by side,"
He said so long ago.

[Chorus]
So come, oh come, and climb with me,
To Heavenly Father's door;
He'll teach us all His gentle ways,
And love us even more.

[Verse 2]
Scout looked out the window wide
And saw a castle bright,
"It's shining just like something gold,"
Scout whispered in delight.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
We fold our arms and bow our heads
And whisper soft and low,
"It's peaceful here inside Your house,
The gentlest place I know."

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
The mountain top is quiet now,
And Heavenly Father's near;
So fold your hands and drift to sleep,
His peaceful house is here.

[Chorus]
mood: Ascending music. A slow, steady climb under the voice, like small feet going up a hill one patient step at a time and finding the door already open. A hymn-like piano carries the step with a faint organ underneath, warming rather than swelling, so the room feels larger and calmer at once. It settles fully still for the final chorus, the way a family goes quiet the moment they are actually inside.
